thread:
Bethany (AE): Passing Grandis over to CS — signed last week, 20-seat seat-based contract, on Dedicated; main asks: SSO (Okta), private VPC peering, and a one-week pilot of the fine-tuned summarization model. Renewal horizon: 11 months; flagged pricing sensitivity (finance wants usage guardrails). Sending context + links. https://crm.redwood.ai/deals/GRANDIS-421 :thumbsup:
Alex Chen: Thanks Bethany — grabbing this. Quick Q: is there customer infra ready for peering or do they want Redwood Private onsite?
Bethany (AE): They have an AWS account ready, pointed at us via partner network. Prefer VPC peering. SSO should be standard Okta OIDC with scim provisioning later. Pilot: 1wk, 5k tokens/day estimate. No PII expected but they asked about audit logs.
Alex Chen: Cool. I'll own onboarding + renewal health. I'll kick off enablement play and assign owners below.
Alex Chen: Tara — can you handle SSO mapping and test plan?
Tara Singh: On it. I'll draft the Okta SAML/OIDC checklist and request an org admin from Grandis. ETA: EOD Wed.
Alex Chen: Jon — you ok to take network peering + infra reqs?
Jon Patel: Yes. I'll create the peering request, list subnet ranges, and open the support ticket to eng infra. Plan: pre-provision dev peering first. Need contact for their infra engineer.
Bethany (AE): @Jon I added their infra contact: michael.grandis@grandis.com. Also copied procurement for contract questions.
Alex Chen: Maria — run customer success QA on pilot prompts and metrics capture (latency, token usage, quality). Put together an eval prompt set and a dashboard template.
Maria Gomez: Will do. I'll also add a usage alert policy (email + pager if >80% of forecasted tokens).
Alex Chen: Ravi (Solutions) — please standby for any model or routing adjustments if latency or quality regressions show up during pilot.
Ravi (Solutions): Roger. If we need a smaller model variant or quantized build for cost, I'll prepare a fallback plan. Also will capture model eval baselines.
Support-Bot: Created ticket #CS-7983 for Grandis onboarding. Link: https://support.redwood.ai/tickets/CS-7983
Alex Chen: Next steps recap: 1) Tara: Okta checklist & admin request (EOD Wed) 2) Jon: VPC peering request + infra contact (48h) 3) Maria: pilot eval set + dashboard (3 days) 4) Ravi: fallback routing plan (5 days) 5) Bethany: secure procurement note on renewal sensitivity and usage caps.
Bethany (AE): I'll draft a short runbook for their exec sponsor on renewal guardrails and share it here by tomorrow.
Tara Singh: One question — do we require SCIM for provisioning in pilot?
Alex Chen: Not for pilot. Manual provisioning is fine. Add SCIM as optional in the runbook.
Jon Patel: I'll post the initial peering request in the ticket and @Alex for approval before we schedule maintenance window.
Maria Gomez: I'll include token spend forecast and a daily digest email to their admin.
Ravi (Solutions): I'll set up automated eval snapshot run daily during the pilot and attach results to CS-7983.
Alex Chen: Great. Can everyone react with :white_check_mark: when they have their first deliverable posted to CS-7983? We need to be ready for the pilot start next Monday.
Bethany (AE): :white_check_mark:
Tara Singh: :white_check_mark:
Jon Patel: :white_check_mark:
Maria Gomez: :white_check_mark:
Ravi (Solutions): :white_check_mark:
Alex Chen: Thanks team — ping me if anything blocks. I'll follow up Friday morning for a status sync.
